publication: Rudolf Stübe, Jüdisch-babylonische Zaubertexte (Halle a/S.: J. Krause, 1895)

capture.assembled_from: The 92 page images named by the Bayerische Staatsbibliothek IIIF manifest, preserved in manifest order without alteration.
visual_checks: Scan page 35 / printed page 13: catalogue entries 1-4, including VA 2412, VA 2413, VA 2432 and VA 2416
Scan page 44 / printed page 22: transcription headed VA 2416

rights.use_note: Keep the library scan private unless its non-commercial digitization terms are satisfied separately; the 1895 underlying text may be used on an expired-copyright basis after transcription and proofreading review.

scope.catalogue: Printed pages 13-18 describe nineteen numbered items: seventeen bowls and two inscribed skulls (nos. 14-15).
scope.inventory_numbers: Nos. 1-17 give VA inventory numbers except nos. 18-19; nos. 18-19 are explicitly two different bowls with Pahlavi inscriptions.
scope.edition: VA 2416 is transcribed and translated on printed pages 22-27, compared with Wohlstein on pages 28-32, and followed by commentary.
scope.reconciliation_policy: Attach Stübe appearances to the existing modern Berlin catalogue records only where the printed VA inventory number is exact. Preserve nos. 18-19 as separate provisional candidates because Stübe supplies no inventory numbers. Do not merge the separate Waller or Levene candidates automatically.
